claim_reviews.claim: jalur sepeda means bicycle lane in Indonesian
lorong basikal means bicycle lane in Malaysian Malay
The forms are different common words across the two languages
The cue accurately specifies a road lane designated for bicycles

rationale: The English sense is clear, and both translations are valid ordinary terms for a bicycle lane. The Malaysian alternative “laluan basikal” reflects a preference variation, not an error. The different-common-word relation is appropriate.
